Thank you very much for that offer, Stephen! — I live in Berlin, though, so meeting up in person will require a bit
of organizational effort. It is quite likely that I will be in the area again soon.
I am very interested in integrating cognition, ie building cognitive architectures, understanding the nature and
organization of mental representation on a functional (not necessarily neurobiological) level, and somewhere
down the road I would like to learn more about the emergence of visual/perceptual grammars, mental simulation,
and the genesis of language. I think I have some basic understanding how to build a computational model of
motivation (helpful for attaching relevance to mental content, and providing reinforcement signals for openended learning, social interaction and exploration), and how to conceive of affect as a configuration of cognitive
modulators. (I wrote a cognitive architecture, MicroPsi, and a book on the topic, called "Principles of Synthetic
Intelligence", from OUP.)
Cheers,
Joscha

Thanks, Jeffrey!
Joscha: If you live in the SF Bay area, let's find a time for a cup of tea or a drink. If you don't live around here,
where do you live?
